tldr: Major US stock indices, including the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite, closed lower due to renewed fears about AI spending.
Crypto exchange Binance has resumed withdrawals and stated it covered 90% of losses from a $6.3 billion hack attributed to North Korea.
A federal judge dismissed Donald Trump's $10 billion defamation lawsuit against The Wall Street Journal and Rupert Murdoch concerning a story about his ties to Jeffrey Epstein.

market.why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite closed lower, marking a week of declines as Big Tech earnings reignited fears about AI spending and sent investors towards defensive stocks.

yield_10y.why: The articles do not provide a specific reason for the 10-year Treasury yield's decrease.

vix.why: The VIX increased, reflecting heightened market uncertainty and volatility, particularly following concerns about AI spending impacts on tech stocks.

mortgage.why: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate slightly decreased this week, tracking the recent downward movement of the 10-year Treasury yield.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: This document contains final regulations regarding the deduction for certain taxpayers for an amount up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.
policy_upcoming.effect: You can deduct up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: Final rules set forth requirements for price transparency reporting for non-grandfathered group health plans and health insurance issuers.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your employer health insurance plan has new price transparency reporting requirements that become effective on December 7, 2026.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_week.what_happened: Final rules set forth requirements for price transparency reporting for non-grandfathered group health plans and health insurance issuers.
policy_week.effect: Your employer health insurance plan has new price transparency reporting requirements that become effective on December 7, 2026.

policy_calendar.label: ACA marketplace open enrollment opens — expected early November
policy_calendar.note: healthcare.gov has opened enrollment on November 1 each year, and currently publishes December 15 as the deadline for coverage starting January 1. The window is set by federal rule and has been changed by rulemaking before.

policy_calendar.label: IRS 401(k) and IRA contribution limits for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: The annual cost-of-living adjustment notice, historically released within a week or two of the bracket figures. It sets how much can go into a 401(k) and an IRA next year.

policy_calendar.label: IRS tax brackets and the married-filing-jointly standard deduction for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: Published as an annual inflation-adjustment revenue procedure; recent releases landed between mid-October and mid-November. These are the bracket thresholds and the standard deduction the next return is filed against.

policy_calendar.label: FHFA conforming loan limit for next year — expected late November
policy_calendar.note: The cap on a conforming (non-jumbo) mortgage, and the line between a normal rate and a jumbo one. FHFA has announced it in the last days of November each year, and the new limit applies to loans made from January 1.

tech.summary: Crypto firm Binance resumed withdrawals after a $6.3 billion hack and announced it has covered 90% of the stolen user assets, with the remaining 10% also to be covered.
Experiments with AI agent swarms in Minecraft aimed at building a civilization reportedly failed, as the 50-agent teams became bogged down in bureaucracy.
A Brazilian court sanctioned lawyers for using prompt injection in a court filing, indicating emerging legal implications for the use of AI in professional contexts.

world.summary: John Healey, a UK politician, stated that an apology over Britain's historic role in the slave trade would not lead to financial reparations.
Australian home values have decreased for the seventh consecutive month, as rising interest rates continue to suppress demand in the property market.
Iran and the US are exploring diplomatic avenues amidst escalating threats of war, with Iran indicating it could reopen the Strait of Hormuz more quickly if conditions are met.

us.summary: A federal judge dismissed Donald Trump's $10 billion defamation lawsuit against The Wall Street Journal and Rupert Murdoch, describing the legal action as "grasping at straws."
Communities in the Southwest's 'Four Corners' region are preparing for further flooding after several weeks of damaging storms have impacted parts of the area.

science.summary: The Food and Drug Administration has approved a gene therapy for Sanfilippo syndrome, a development significantly aided by millions of dollars in research funding raised by an affected family.
Florida is experiencing a record number of dengue fever cases this year, as the tropical disease finds favorable conditions in warming climates.

weekly_recap: This week, major U.S. stock indices saw declines as turmoil in the artificial intelligence sector led to tech selling. In Europe, widespread protests continued, and globally, significant events included a deadly church attack in Jordan, Kim Jong-un's visit to China, and Lula da Silva securing a historic fourth term as Brazil's president. Serbia's President Aleksandar Vučić was ousted by a student-led movement, and Israel held general elections. Apple refreshed its iMac and MacBook Pro lines with new M6 chips, while the UK Chancellor John Healey's budget included energy payments and a bank tax increase. A high-speed train collision in Spain resulted in numerous fatalities. The U.S. economy experienced faster-than-expected growth in the third quarter, driven by consumer spending and AI investments, and DoorDash announced its acquisition of Instacart. Tech stocks suffered a significant downturn, pushing the Nasdaq into its first three-week losing streak since March, and security gaps were reported for AI companies Anthropic and OpenAI.
